title: Stack Size Modifier
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that increases the maximum stack size of Ender Pearls, Potions, Buckets, and more to 64
body:
Stack Size Modifier is a simple and lightweight Fabric mod that increases the maximum stack size of specific items to 64, improving inventory management without altering vanilla game mechanics.

🚀 Features

- The following items can now be stacked up to 64:
- 🎯 Throwable Items (Default: 16)
- Ender Pearl
- Snowball
- Egg


🧪 Potions & Bottles (Default: 1)
- Potion (Drinkable)
- Splash Potion
- Lingering Potion
- Honey Bottle (Default: 16)
- Glass Bottle


🪣 Buckets (Default: 1)
- Water Bucket
- Lava Bucket
- Milk Bucket
- Bucket (Empty - Default: 16)


🛠️ Technical Details
- Mod Loader: Fabric
- Minecraft Version: 1.21.7
- Compatibility: Works on both Client and Server.
